```{r}
#| label: load-data
#| include: false

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(maps)
library(lubridate)

keep <- c(
  "TIMESTAMP_START", "TIMESTAMP_END",
  "TA_F", "SW_IN_F", "VPD_F", "P_F",
  "NETRAD", "G_F_MDS",
  "H_F_MDS", "H_F_MDS_QC",
  "LE_F_MDS", "LE_F_MDS_QC",
  "NEE_VUT_REF", "NEE_VUT_REF_QC",
  "GPP_NT_VUT_REF", "RECO_NT_VUT_REF"
)

read_hh <- function(zip_file) {

  hh_name <- grep(
    "FLUXMET_HH",
    unzip(zip_file, list = TRUE)$Name,
    value = TRUE
  )

  unzip(
    zip_file,
    files = hh_name,
    exdir = "data/raw/unzipped"
  )

  site_id <- strsplit(
    basename(hh_name), "_"
  )[[1]][2]

  hh <- read_csv(
    file.path("data/raw/unzipped", hh_name),
    na = "-9999",
    col_select = any_of(keep),
    col_types = cols(
      TIMESTAMP_START = "c",
      TIMESTAMP_END = "c",
      .default = "d"
    )
  ) |>
    mutate(
      time = as.POSIXct(
        TIMESTAMP_START,
        format = "%Y%m%d%H%M",
        tz = "UTC"
      ),
      site = site_id
    )

  return(hh)
}

zip_files <- list.files(
  "data/raw",
  pattern = "\\.zip$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

stopifnot(length(zip_files) == 5)

hh_all <- bind_rows(
  lapply(zip_files, read_hh)
)
```

## Introduction

This report provides an overview of five FLUXNET towers
and their half-hourly flux and meteorological measurements.
The aim is to assess site characteristics, data coverage
and the distribution of key environmental variables.

Timestamps are provided in local standard time without
daylight-saving adjustments. UTC is used only as a
container for storing timestamps in R.

Missing values (-9999) were converted to NA during
data import.

## C1. Site overview

The five selected flux towers represent different
geographical locations and ecosystem types.

## C1. Site overview

The five selected FLUXNET towers are located in
the United States, Switzerland, Spain, Denmark and Japan.

```{r}
#| echo: false

snapshot <- read_csv(
  "data/snapshots/fluxnet_shuttle_snapshot_20261119T174438.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

countries <- c(
  US = "United States",
  CH = "Switzerland",
  ES = "Spain",
  DK = "Denmark",
  JP = "Japan"
)

sites <- snapshot |>
  filter(site_id %in% unique(hh_all$site)) |>
  mutate(
    country = unname(countries[substr(site_id, 1, 2)])
  ) |>
  select(
    site_id,
    site_name,
    country,
    igbp,
    location_lat,
    location_long,
    first_year,
    last_year,
    network,
    product_citation
  ) |>
  distinct()

kable(
  sites,
  col.names = c(
    "Site ID",
    "Site name",
    "Country",
    "IGBP class",
    "Latitude",
    "Longitude",
    "First year",
    "Last year",
    "Network",
    "Data citation"
  ),
  digits = 3
)
```

## C2. Data coverage

Data coverage was assessed as the proportion of half-hourly
NEE observations that were directly measured
(NEE_VUT_REF_QC = 0).

```{r}
#| echo: false

coverage <- hh_all |>
  mutate(year = year(time)) |>
  group_by(site, year) |>
  summarise(
    share_measured = sum(
      NEE_VUT_REF_QC == 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) / n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(
  coverage,
  aes(x = year, y = site, fill = share_measured)
) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    labels = scales::label_percent()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Coverage of measured NEE",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Site",
    fill = "Measured NEE"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#| echo: false

best_coverage <- coverage |>
  slice_max(share_measured, n = 1, with_ties = TRUE)
```

The highest data coverage was recorded at
`r paste(paste0(best_coverage$site, " (", best_coverage$year, ")"), collapse = ", ")`,
with `r round(max(best_coverage$share_measured) * 100, 1)`%
of half-hourly NEE observations directly measured.
## C3. Summary statistics

Summary statistics were calculated for the main flux
and meteorological variables at each site.

For precipitation, the mean annual sum was calculated
using complete years without missing precipitation values.

```{r}
#| echo: false

variables <- c(
  "TA_F", "SW_IN_F", "VPD_F", "P_F",
  "NEE_VUT_REF", "GPP_NT_VUT_REF",
  "RECO_NT_VUT_REF", "H_F_MDS", "LE_F_MDS"
)

units <- c(
  TA_F = "°C",
  SW_IN_F = "W/m²",
  VPD_F = "hPa",
  P_F = "mm/30 min",
  NEE_VUT_REF = "µmol CO2/m²/s",
  GPP_NT_VUT_REF = "µmol CO2/m²/s",
  RECO_NT_VUT_REF = "µmol CO2/m²/s",
  H_F_MDS = "W/m²",
  LE_F_MDS = "W/m²"
)

stats <- hh_all |>
  select(site, all_of(variables)) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -site,
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  group_by(site, variable) |>
  summarise(
    Mean = if (all(is.na(value))) NA_real_
           else mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),

    Minimum = if (all(is.na(value))) NA_real_
              else min(value, na.rm = TRUE),

    Maximum = if (all(is.na(value))) NA_real_
              else max(value, na.rm = TRUE),

    Missing = mean(is.na(value)) * 100,

    .groups = "drop"
  )

precipitation <- hh_all |>
  mutate(year = year(time)) |>
  group_by(site, year) |>
  summarise(
    annual_sum = if (
      n() == 48 * ifelse(
        leap_year(first(year)), 366, 365
      ) && !anyNA(P_F)
    ) sum(P_F) else NA_real_,

    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  group_by(site) |>
  summarise(
    mean_annual_precipitation =
      if (all(is.na(annual_sum))) NA_real_
      else mean(annual_sum, na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

stats <- stats |>
  left_join(precipitation, by = "site") |>
  mutate(
    Unit = unname(units[variable]),

    Mean = if_else(
      variable == "P_F",
      mean_annual_precipitation,
      Mean
    ),

    Mean_unit = if_else(
      variable == "P_F",
      "mm/year",
      Unit
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

for (s in unique(stats$site)) {

  cat("\n\n### ", s, "\n\n")

  table_site <- stats |>
    filter(site == s) |>
    select(
      variable, Mean, Mean_unit,
      Minimum, Maximum, Unit, Missing
    )

  print(
    kable(
      table_site,
      digits = 2,
      col.names = c(
        "Variable",
        "Mean",
        "Mean unit",
        "Minimum",
        "Maximum",
        "Min/Max unit",
        "Missing (%)"
      )
    )
  )

  cat("\n\n")
}
```
## C4. Time series

Half-hourly measurements of NEE, GPP and RECO were
aggregated to daily means and converted from
µmol CO2 m-2 s-1 to g C m-2 d-1 using a
conversion factor of 1.0378.

Only days with 48 valid half-hourly values per
variable were included in the daily aggregation.

```{r}
#| echo: false

daily <- hh_all |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(time, tz = "UTC")) |>
  group_by(site, date) |>
  summarise(
    across(
      c(NEE_VUT_REF, GPP_NT_VUT_REF, RECO_NT_VUT_REF),
      ~ if (length(.x) == 48 && !anyNA(.x)) {
        mean(.x) * 1.0378
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

daily_long <- daily |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      NEE_VUT_REF,
      GPP_NT_VUT_REF,
      RECO_NT_VUT_REF
    ),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "carbon_flux"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    variable = recode(
      variable,
      NEE_VUT_REF = "NEE",
      GPP_NT_VUT_REF = "GPP",
      RECO_NT_VUT_REF = "RECO"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 12

ggplot(
  daily_long,
  aes(
    x = date,
    y = carbon_flux,
    colour = variable
  )
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    colour = "grey50"
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ site,
    ncol = 1,
    scales = "free_x"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      NEE = "steelblue",
      GPP = "forestgreen",
      RECO = "orange"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Daily carbon fluxes",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Carbon flux (g C m-2 d-1)",
    colour = "Variable"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
### Validation against FLUXMET_DD

The calculated daily NEE values were compared with
the official daily FLUXMET product for one site.

```{r}
#| echo: false

check_zip <- zip_files[1]

dd_name <- grep(
  "FLUXMET_DD",
  unzip(check_zip, list = TRUE)$Name,
  value = TRUE
)

unzip(
  check_zip,
  files = dd_name,
  exdir = "data/raw/unzipped"
)

check_site <- strsplit(
  basename(dd_name), "_"
)[[1]][2]

dd <- read_csv(
  file.path("data/raw/unzipped", dd_name),
  na = "-9999",
  col_select = any_of(
    c("TIMESTAMP", "NEE_VUT_REF")
  ),
  col_types = cols(
    TIMESTAMP = "c",
    .default = "d"
  )
) |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(
      TIMESTAMP,
      format = "%Y%m%d"
    )
  )

comparison <- daily |>
  filter(site == check_site) |>
  select(date, calculated = NEE_VUT_REF) |>
  inner_join(
    dd |>
      select(date, official = NEE_VUT_REF),
    by = "date"
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(calculated),
    !is.na(official)
  )

comparison |>
  summarise(
    Site = check_site,
    Days_compared = n(),
    Correlation = cor(calculated, official),
    Mean_absolute_difference =
      mean(abs(calculated - official))
  ) |>
  kable(digits = 4)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false

ggplot(
  comparison,
  aes(x = official, y = calculated)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    colour = "red"
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = paste("Daily aggregation check:", check_site),
    x = "Official daily NEE (g C m-2 d-1)",
    y = "Calculated daily NEE (g C m-2 d-1)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
## C5. Diurnal cycles

Mean diurnal cycles of NEE and latent heat flux (LE)
were calculated for each site and season.

Meteorological seasons were defined using the latitude
of each site. For sites in the Southern Hemisphere,
seasons were reversed relative to the Northern Hemisphere.

All five selected sites are located in the
Northern Hemisphere.

```{r}
#| echo: false

diurnal <- hh_all |>
  left_join(
    sites |>
      select(site_id, location_lat) |>
      distinct(),
    by = c("site" = "site_id")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    month = month(time),

    hour_of_day = hour(time) + minute(time) / 60,

    season = case_when(
      month %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ "Spring",
      month %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ "Summer",
      month %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Autumn",
      TRUE ~ "Winter"
    ),

    season = case_when(
      location_lat < 0 & season == "Spring" ~ "Autumn",
      location_lat < 0 & season == "Summer" ~ "Winter",
      location_lat < 0 & season == "Autumn" ~ "Spring",
      location_lat < 0 & season == "Winter" ~ "Summer",
      TRUE ~ season
    ),

    season = factor(
      season,
      levels = c(
        "Spring", "Summer",
        "Autumn", "Winter"
      )
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(site, season, hour_of_day) |>
  summarise(
    NEE = mean(NEE_VUT_REF, na.rm = TRUE),
    LE = mean(LE_F_MDS, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 7

diurnal_long <- diurnal |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(NEE, LE),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    variable = recode(
      variable,
      NEE = "NEE (µmol CO2 m-2 s-1)",
      LE = "LE (W m-2)"
    )
  )

ggplot(
  diurnal_long,
  aes(
    x = hour_of_day,
    y = value,
    colour = site
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_grid(
    variable ~ season,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(0, 6, 12, 18, 24)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean seasonal diurnal cycles",
    x = "Hour of day (local standard time)",
    y = NULL,
    colour = "Site"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
## C6. Interpretation

### C6.1. Energy balance closure

Energy balance closure was assessed by comparing
the sum of sensible and latent heat fluxes (H + LE)
with available energy (NETRAD - G).

Only half-hourly observations with directly measured
H and LE values (QC = 0) and available radiation
and ground heat flux data were included.

```{r}
#| echo: false

energy <- hh_all |>
  filter(
    H_F_MDS_QC == 0,
    LE_F_MDS_QC == 0,
    !is.na(H_F_MDS),
    !is.na(LE_F_MDS),
    !is.na(NETRAD),
    !is.na(G_F_MDS)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    available_energy = NETRAD - G_F_MDS,
    turbulent_flux = H_F_MDS + LE_F_MDS
  )

energy_sites <- energy |>
  count(site, sort = TRUE)

stopifnot(nrow(energy_sites) > 0)

energy_site <- energy_sites$site[1]

energy_data <- energy |>
  filter(site == energy_site)

energy_model <- lm(
  turbulent_flux ~ available_energy,
  data = energy_data
)

energy_slope <- coef(energy_model)[2]

energy_r2 <- summary(energy_model)$r.squared
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 6

ggplot(
  energy_data,
  aes(
    x = available_energy,
    y = turbulent_flux
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.08,
    size = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    colour = "red",
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = FALSE,
    colour = "steelblue"
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = paste("Energy balance closure:", energy_site),
    subtitle = paste(
      "Slope =", round(energy_slope, 3),
      "| R² =", round(energy_r2, 3)
    ),
    x = "NETRAD - G (W m-2)",
    y = "H + LE (W m-2)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

The energy balance was evaluated at site
`r energy_site`, using `r nrow(energy_data)`
valid half-hourly observations.

The slope of the linear regression was
`r round(energy_slope, 3)`, with an R-squared
of `r round(energy_r2, 3)`.


### C6.2. Comparison of the five sites

```{r}
#| echo: false

annual_carbon <- daily |>
  mutate(year = year(date)) |>
  group_by(site, year) |>
  summarise(
    annual_NEE = if (
      n_distinct(date) ==
        ifelse(leap_year(first(year)), 366, 365) &&
      !anyNA(NEE_VUT_REF)
    ) {
      sum(NEE_VUT_REF)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

carbon_summary <- annual_carbon |>
  group_by(site) |>
  summarise(
    complete_years = sum(!is.na(annual_NEE)),
    mean_annual_NEE = if (all(is.na(annual_NEE))) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      mean(annual_NEE, na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(mean_annual_NEE)

kable(
  carbon_summary,
  digits = 2,
  col.names = c(
    "Site",
    "Complete years",
    "Mean annual NEE (g C m-2 yr-1)"
  )
)
```
```{r}
#| echo: false

seasonal_amplitude <- daily |>
  mutate(month = month(date)) |>
  group_by(site, month) |>
  summarise(
    monthly_NEE = mean(
      NEE_VUT_REF,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  group_by(site) |>
  summarise(
    amplitude = if (
      all(is.finite(monthly_NEE)) &&
      n() == 12
    ) {
      max(monthly_NEE) - min(monthly_NEE)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(amplitude))

kable(
  seasonal_amplitude,
  digits = 2,
  col.names = c(
    "Site",
    "Seasonal NEE amplitude (g C m-2 d-1)"
  )
)
```
```{r}
#| echo: false

gap_summary <- hh_all |>
  group_by(site) |>
  summarise(
    measured = mean(
      NEE_VUT_REF_QC %in% 0 &
      !is.na(NEE_VUT_REF)
    ) * 100,

    gap_filled = mean(
      NEE_VUT_REF_QC %in% c(1, 2, 3) &
      !is.na(NEE_VUT_REF)
    ) * 100,

    missing_or_unknown =
      100 - measured - gap_filled,

    .groups = "drop"
  )

kable(
  gap_summary,
  digits = 2,
  col.names = c(
    "Site",
    "Measured (%)",
    "Gap-filled (%)",
    "Missing or unknown (%)"
  )
)
```
Among the five investigated sites, JP-Hc3 showed the highest annual net carbon uptake. In contrast, ES-LJu showed the lowest net carbon uptake. The largest seasonal variation in NEE was observed at DK-Sor. Differences between the sites may be related to vegetation type, climatic conditions and the length of the growing season. The diurnal cycles revealed differences in carbon uptake and latent heat flux between seasons. I was particularly surprised by high carbon storage of the cropland in Japan. The proportion of gap-filled NEE data varied considerably between the sites, ranging from 32.88	% to 75.86%.
